lines.trans: Quiet everyone, I need complete silence!
Chef, we have already turned off all noisy equipment.
Be quiet, I demand absolute calm in the kitchen.
All the cooks fell silent and are standing in place.
Do not breathe, I want to hear every quiet sound.
Are you sure our little guest is here?
She definitely hid somewhere in this dining room.
I hear a strange faint rustling near the table.
Who is standing there near the big refrigerator right now?
There is no one there, only large boxes of groceries.
Look carefully, the girl is sitting right under the table!
What joy, we finally found our missing one!
